verbatim-ship sentinel: this file must ship byte-for-byte, untouched.

{{ not_a_template_var }} {% not_a_tag %} {# not_a_comment #}

If any renderer ever routes verbatim-map entries through Jinja, these
literal tokens raise (StrictUndefined / TemplateSyntaxError) or change
the bytes — either way `test_verbatim_entries_bypass_jinja` goes red.
Bucket B ships prompt files with literal JSON-fence braces through the
same map; this sentinel is the guard for that contract.
